_comment: Single source of campaign settings. Keys mirror the launch variables: CAMPAIGN_ENABLED=enabled, CAMPAIGN_NAME=campaignName, TARGET_COUNTRY=targetCountry, POPUP_DELAY_MS=popupDelayMs, POPUP_SCROLL_THRESHOLD=popupScrollThreshold, DISMISSAL_DAYS=dismissalDays, CAMPAIGN_PERIOD=campaignPeriod, APPLICATION_STATUS=applicationStatus. After editing run: python3 tools/fam_trip_build.py && python3 tools/sitemaps.py
